description: A search cancelled while in flight. `debug_stall_ms` holds the search before it reads anything, the cancel notification arrives while it is still waiting, and the adapter answers with an error rather than a late result — the core has already told its caller this source did not answer, so a result arriving afterwards is worse than none. The code is -32007 deadline_exceeded: a request abandoned in flight ran out of time, which is a different condition from an adapter declining a budget up front. Recording this case at all depends on the format's rule that a notification is sent without waiting.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
